acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

For each FAIMS fraction, data‐dependent acquisition was undertaken with a single Orbitrap MS scan (300–2000 m/z, a resolution of 60k with the automated gain control (AGC) set to a maximum of 400%) collected every 3 s followed by Orbitrap MS/MS HCD scans of precursors (Quad isolation window width of 1.6 m/z, stepped normalized collision energy of 35;38;45%, maximal injection time of 118 ms, a resolution of 60k and a AGC of 500%, lower mass cut off set at 120 m/z).

fractionation_method.evidence: Online fractionation by high‐FAIMS and mass spectrometry (MS) analysis

Herein, we compare the previously published enrichment free N-terminomics approach using high-field asymmetric waveform ion mobility spectrometry (FAIMS) to offline basic reverse-phase (bRP) fractionation to assess the complementarity of these fractionation methods for simultaneous proteomic and degradomic analysis.
